business_summary.text: Belrise Industries (formerly Badve Engineering) makes safety-critical automotive systems such as chassis, exhaust systems, BIW parts, suspensions and steering columns for 2W, 3W, 4W and CV OEMs, and is expanding into defence and aerospace.

call_points.text: Hyva India's tipper business, adding Pune, Jamshedpur and Bengaluru facilities, is expected to complete in Q3 FY27.
Adding a brownfield set-up for a US solar tracker OEM, supplying sheet-metal assemblies for 2.5 GW annually.
Capex guided at 6-6.5% of manufacturing revenue, including R&D.
New order from fastest-growing two/three-wheeler OEM for exhaust systems and fuel tanks, ₹90 Cr peak revenue, production from Q2FY27.
Japanese two-wheeler OEM order for exhaust systems and metal components, ~₹220 Cr peak revenue, production from Q4FY27.
Haridwar facility ramp-up progressing; trial parts dispatched, peak production expected this fiscal year.
Back-to-back raw material pricing passes steel and plastic cost swings to customers with a lag.
Net debt ₹597.7 Cr at 31 March 2026; ROCE 14.7%.
Oil crisis, energy, logistics and Haryana minimum wage costs pressured Q4; fuel and labour costs to be passed on over time.
Management declined to give plant-level utilisation or break-even timelines for new facilities.
Suspension business serves only two- and three-wheelers, not passenger vehicles; no revenue-share target given.

guidance.statement: We expect to continue delivering mid-teens revenue growth, consistent with our track record and momentum in our order book.
We expect EBITDA margins to remain broadly stable as compared to our FY26 levels.
We expect capex to remain in the range of 6% to 6.5% of our manufacturing revenue.
We expect SDM to be EBITDA positive in the year 2027.
We want it to be a meaningful contributor to our revenues, growing upwards of 10%.
Belrise aims to grow its 4W/CV segment revenue by 40-45% in FY27 from the FY25 base.

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Automobile and Auto Components > Auto Components > Auto Components & Equipments

operating_notes.text: Two-wheeler content per vehicle rose from about ₹12,000 to ₹20,000 (60-65%) including the merger of Badve Autocomps and Eximius; four-wheeler content per vehicle rose from about ₹25,000 to ₹40,000-45,000 with H-One.
The company has more than 850 robots and more than 163 people in its R&D team.
Chester Hall had CY2025 revenue over GBP18.5 million, EBITDA of about GBP2.1 million and ROCE over 20%; it was acquired for GBP13.2 million.
Manufacturing revenue was ₹2,198 Cr in Q1FY27, up 20%, while trading revenue fell 19% to ₹348.6 Cr.
Exports were 12.7% of manufacturing revenue in Q1FY27, down from 13.8% in Q1FY26.
The company has 38 manufacturing facilities across 13 cities in 10 states and 3 countries, with 90,000+ MTPA annual production capacity.

holders.name: Nippon Life India Trustee Ltd-A/C Nippon India Small Cap Fund

timeline.summary: On 25 May 2026 Belrise Industries held its Q4/FY26 earnings call, reporting FY26 revenue up 15% to ₹9,509 Cr and adjusted PAT up 41% to ₹502 Cr, and guiding mid-teens FY27 growth with stable margins.
